name: Costiera Amalfitana
description: The Amalfi Coast is a dramatic stretch of southern Italy's Campania region, where steep cliffs drop to the Tyrrhenian Sea along the Gulf of Salerno. Pastel-coloured towns such as Amalfi and Ravello cling to the slopes, which have been settled since the early Middle Ages. Terraced vineyards and orchards climb the hillsides toward high upland pastures, making it as rewarding to walk as to admire from the water.
